title: Destiny2FootageVideo
description: Video-level record for one Bungie official Destiny YouTube video in the retrieval index. PROVENANCE PATTERN: all tagged fields are stored as plain typed values at the top level of the record (flat fields), and every tagged field MAY have a matching entry in the parallel `provenance` object, keyed by the exact field name, with {source, label_source, confidence}. `source` is 'observed' when the value was determined from this video's own metadata/frames and 'inherited' when copied from a parent record (at video level, values are normally 'observed'; segments inherit these video-scoped defaults). `label_source` is who/what produced the label: manual | heuristic | model. `confidence` is 0..1. Video-scoped defaults (era, activity, content_type, destination) are inherited by every segment of this video unless the segment overrides them with its own observed value.

video_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this video within the index (e.g. 'yt_final_shape_launch_trailer'). Segments reference this via segment.video_id.

youtube_url.description: Canonical YouTube watch URL for the video.

title.description: YouTube video title as published by Bungie.

description.description: YouTube video description text as published by Bungie.

youtube_tags.description: Creator-supplied YouTube tags on the video.

playlist.description: Name of the Bungie YouTube playlist this video was sourced from, if any.

usage_class.description: Rights bucket for this asset. Always 'third_party_copyrighted': the footage is Bungie, Inc. copyrighted material.

source_rights_note.description: Human-readable rights note. Should state that Bungie's fan-content policy permits non-commercial fan creations (including fan music videos) using Bungie assets, and that this index stores metadata and timestamps only, not the footage.

provenance.description: Parallel provenance map, keyed by tagged field name (era, activity, content_type, destination). Each value is a provenanceEntry. Convention: every tagged field present on this record SHOULD have a matching entry here.

source.description: inherited = copied from a parent scope (segment inherits from video); observed = determined directly from this record's own metadata or frames.

label_source.description: Who/what produced the label: a human (manual), a deterministic rule (heuristic), or an ML model (model).

era.description: Destiny release era the footage belongs to (d1_base = original Destiny through the_final_shape). Use 'unknown' when it cannot be determined. Default for all segments of this video.

activity.description: Activity type depicted. 'cinematic' covers pre-rendered or engine cinematics not tied to a playable activity. Default for all segments of this video.

content_type.description: Nature of the footage itself. 'trailer' = edited promotional trailer; 'cinematic' = pre-rendered cinematic; 'cutscene' = in-engine story cutscene; 'gameplay' = captured play. Default for all segments; a segment MAY override (e.g. a gameplay shot inside a trailer video).

destination.description: Controlled vocabulary of in-fiction Destiny locations. Use 'unknown' when the destination is unclear or not in the controlled list. Optional at video level (a trailer may span many destinations).
